title: Fluid Tank
subtitle: Sixteen buckets of one fluid
text:
A Fluid Tank holds 16 buckets of a single fluid and shows its level through the glass. Pipes join it on any face.

Use a bucket on it to pour in or fill up. Broken tanks keep what is inside.
caption: Pipes in, pipes out

steps.note:
Crafting Table
4x Copper Plate, 2x Iron Plate, 2x Glass, 1x Bucket

steps.text: Set the pipe end on the tank to output to drain it into the rest of the run.
